question: Which suppliers are linked to product defects?

candidates.query: SELECT ?s WHERE { ?s a :Supplier . ?y a :Yield . ?l a :Lot . ?p a :Product . ?l :HAS_DEFECT ?y . ?l :PRODUCED_FOR ?p . }
SELECT ?s WHERE { ?s a :Supplier . ?m a :Material . ?ps a :ProcessStep . ?d a :Defect . ?p a :Product . ?s :SUPPLIES ?m . ?m :USED_IN ?ps . ?ps :HAS_DEFECT ?d . ?d :PRODUCED_FOR ?p . }
SELECT ?s WHERE { ?s a :Supplier . ?m a :Material . ?p a :Product . ?d a :Defect . ?s :SUPPLIES ?m . ?p :REQUIRES ?m . ?p :HAS_DEFECT ?d . }
SELECT ?s WHERE { ?s a :Supplier . ?f a :Fab . ?p a :Product . ?d a :Defect . ?s :SUPPLIES ?f . ?f :PRODUCES ?p . ?p :HAS_DEFECT ?d . }
